# STY003 `function-missing-result`

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="info" text="opt-in" />

A function has no `result(...)` clause.

## Why

Without `result` the function's name is also its result variable: inside the function, `f` is the
value, and a recursive call or a reference to the function as a procedure needs other syntax. A
named result (`result(r)`) separates the two and reads unambiguously.

## Reported

```fortran
function norm2d(x, y)
```

## Preferred

```fortran
function norm2d(x, y) result(r)
```

## Suppressing

For one occurrence, with the reason on the same line (or alone on the line before the statement):

```fortran
! fobis: ignore[STY003] <why this occurrence is fine>
```

For the whole project, `ignore = STY003` in the fobos [`[lint]` section](/fobos/lint).

## Equivalent

Fortitude rule `S221` (see [Lint Rules](/lint-rules/#relation-to-fortitude)).
